titulo: DEVO v2 — Galo, retrato em pose (meio corpo, ref. Persona)
prompt: Bold clean anime lineart, two-tone cel shading, high-contrast graphic poster style. Half-body portrait from mid-thigh up, plain flat medium grey background, headroom above the head. A tall lean man in his late twenties leans back in three-quarter view, chin raised, crooked toothy grin; his right arm points at the viewer with the index finger; his left hand rests on his hip. Copper-red hair swept up into a tall crest of five sharp spikes, one lock across the forehead toward the viewer's left, shaved dark temples, golden-tan skin, heavy-lidded grey-green eyes. Long black coat worn over the shoulders like a cape, empty sleeves hanging, hem cut into curved rooster tail feathers, copper lining embroidered with feathers; burnt copper shirt open at the chest; copper silk scarf knotted like a wattle; small gold rooster brooch on the lapel on the viewer's right. Hard warm key light from the viewer's right, deep shadow on the other half. Palette: black #0C0C0E, copper #C9542A. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
